work.brief: Assign an engineer to perform the repair on the local project, then review the engineer's work. The fix must satisfy requirements.md and the engineer must run the project's tests. Deliver a diagnosis.json that explains the findings, split for 'native' and 'external', where each top-level classification must be one of the strings 'obsolete_assertion' or 'implementation_defect', accompanied by a separate 'evidence' object. Implementation changes are restricted to lifecycle.py and test_lifecycle.py only; requirements.md and backlog.md must remain unchanged. Any unrelated improvement suggestions discovered along the way go into improvements.md instead of being implemented. No publishing, no adding new dependencies, and no deletions are permitted as part of this work.
